From the sea

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A terrace above Konnos Bay

Spartiatis sits on the road above Konnos Bay, Konnos 79, between Protaras and Cape Greco. In the restaurant’s own words: Yiayia Fevronia started it in 1987, local seafood experts serving traditional and modern flavours, with one of Cyprus’ most iconic sea views. Fresh fish is sold by the kilo, the seafood meze is for two or more.

Open every day for lunch from twelve to four and for dinner from half past six.

What guests say

Two of 1,537 Google reviews, 4.6 stars on average.
